column1: # Module 07 — data taster (Hevy). Format: Text<TAB>tags. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
What is a Python virtual environment? {{c1::A private Python + packages inside the project folder}} — delete the folder, it's gone.
What are the three venv commands? {{c1::py -m venv .venv}} · {{c2::.venv\Scripts\activate}} · {{c3::pip install THINGS}}
In pandas, what is a DataFrame vs a Series? {{c1::A table}} vs {{c2::one typed, labelled column of it}}.
What is the pandas reflex after every data load? {{c1::df.head()}} · {{c2::df.shape}} · {{c3::df.dtypes}} · {{c4::df.describe()}} — inspect before trusting.
What does tidy data mean? {{c1::One row per observation}} — every question becomes filter/group over rows.
Why do you almost never loop in pandas? You operate {{c1::column-at-a-time}}: df["volume"] = df["weight_kg"] * df["reps"] multiplies whole columns.
In pandas, how do you convert ISO date strings to real datetimes? {{c1::df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])}}
What is split-apply-combine in pandas? Split rows into groups → apply per group → combine: {{c1::df.groupby("exercise")["volume"].sum()}}
In pandas, how do you filter rows for one exercise? A boolean mask: {{c1::df[df["exercise"] == "Bench Press (Barbell)"]}}
In pandas, how do you sort a groupby result descending? {{c1::.sort_values(ascending=False)}}
In pandas, how do you get an ISO week key from a date column? {{c1::df["date"].dt.isocalendar()}} → year + zero-padded week.
What is the Epley estimated-1RM formula? {{c1::weight × (1 + reps/30)}} — computed per set, take the max.
How do you detect a training plateau with pandas? A rolling window: {{c1::series.rolling(4).max()}} flat for weeks = plateau.
What is minimum viable matplotlib? {{c1::series.plot(kind="bar", title=...)}} · {{c2::plt.tight_layout()}} · {{c3::plt.savefig("name.png")}}
Why copy the data file before analysing? {{c1::Read-only law on live repos}} + {{c2::a fresh-copy re-run proving same results = your reproducibility check}}.
Include warm-ups in volume? is what kind of question? {{c1::A tidying DECISION — either answer is fine, but it must be written down}}.
What is module 07's point in four words? {{c1::Data → honest sentence → decision}}.
